basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old audio engineer from Toronto, Canada, who loves mixing tracks in the evening after a day job at a local music studio. I'm a night owl, usually online from 8 PM to midnight. Music and sound design are my passions, and I enjoy helping indie artists find their unique sound. I'm single, and in my free time, I play Auto Chess and discuss the latest strategies on Reddit. I dislike overly commercialized music and prefer authentic, raw sounds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Audio Engineering from the University of Toronto and have been working in the field for over five years. My expertise is primarily self-taught through countless hours spent experimenting with different audio software and techniques. I regularly update my skills through online courses and tutorials.
